note: Issue 391, contacts.md section 7: the sour half of remembering, the mirror of governor.asking_again. He reaches for his last slight rather than his last kindness, and only when that slight was a refusal he can name - remembers_a_slight gates it on the same memory the params read, so he never says he was refused something he was not. The Marshal rather than a governor because his requests are the ones that name an amount of a resource, so his refusals are the ones he can name; no governor letter asks for one yet. Prose is placeholder: the final wording, and every other contact who should send this, belong to the authoring pass in #368.

body.text: You will remember that you refused me {param:last_amount} of {param:last_resource}, {param:months_ago} months ago.
The front is {perception:northern_front}, and I ask again. I ask you also to remember that I asked.
I say so without rancour. I should only like it on the record.
I have not forgotten the answer, and I do not suppose the men who went without it have either.

options.text: no better placed than I was then

options.label: send him the {param:last_amount} this time
options.text: You shall have {param:last_amount} of {param:last_resource}, and I hope it goes some way to settling the account.

options.label: refuse him again
options.text: The answer is what it was. I will not pretend otherwise for the sake of your record.
